text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim that driverless cars \"should, become an everyday thing\"","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a direct, unmistakable position early so the reader knows the essay's argument right away."},{"evidence":"\"Protecting the people\" ... \"sensors seemingly everywhere\" ... \"real life, real time model of the road\"","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"It draws on multiple details from the article to support the claim with specific factual backing."},{"evidence":"body paragraph on environment and fuel use","quality":"argument development","description":"It builds the case with more than one main reason instead of repeating a single point."},{"evidence":"\"Now, there are flaws...\" followed by liability discussion","quality":"acknowledgement of counterpoints","description":"It recognizes a weakness in the issue and addresses it rather than arguing in a one-sided way."},{"evidence":"\"Driverless cars are the way of the future\" / closing call to make them legal","quality":"conclusion","description":"It ends by restating the position and giving the argument a more purposeful finish."}]}
